about: Liquid d1-2B on different serving engines (Ümit #12966, #13012, #13181, #13211): the 547 kept English reading questions with the prompt and option order of the d1 server's run 708, on one RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell (96 GB), bariton GPU 2, one question per request; and a packing test, one ~2,000-token invoice with 15 choice questions sent as 15 one-question requests or as one 15-question request (median of 5 after a warm-up). Questions per minute: the run's 547 answers over its wall time, from whole-second timestamps. Same answers: questions where the engine chose the same option as run 708. Measured 20 November 2026; none of these runs changes a published score.
